propositions: Operators force-close ~25 of 33 audit ADMINISTRATIVE_CLOSE records because no truthful non-force exit exists for obsolete/superseded/wontfix dispositions on non-bug tickets (tasks/stories/epics).
The completion-FAIL message never mentions the narrow attested-disposition path that exists, leaving operators unaware a reason-based close is valid.
Only bugs can use close --class; non-bugs with non_a_bug/escalated vocabulary have no exit; vocabulary lacks obsolete/superseded/wontfix.

Administrative close classes (duplicate, obsolete, superseded, wontfix) must be discoverable and gated: non-bugs may only use administrative classes; obsolete/wontfix require a reason; replacement-bearing classes demand a live link.
A reason-only administrative close must mint a SIGNED disposition attestation and skip completion verifiers; the precheck refusal message must enumerate applicable --class values per ticket type.
